Heard | Senior Software Engineer (Full-Stack) | Seattle | HYBRID | Full-time

We just crossed $11M ARR and 5,000 customers -- all therapists and mental health providers who trust us to run their financial back office: bookkeeping, taxes, payroll. Now we're building AI-powered CFO for therapists -- a layer on top of our ledger. Think proactive financial guidance, automated transaction classification, reconciliation, and agentic workflows that collapse hours of bookkeeping.

Stack: TypeScript, Node/Express, React, Postgres, AWS, lots of third-party integrations. You'll work across automation, AI product, and growth depending on what matters most. Apply: https://jobs.lever.co/heard/8d51e41d-b9c5-45fd-b9bc-f2a1c7f0...
